secondary_historical.note: WL104D Amendment-1 reference: secondary, repeatedly inspected; descriptive only.

definitions.targets: Lane metrics against the mean of the two reference halves; every *_a / *_b key repeats it against one half.
definitions.e_core / e_shoulder: RGB region-normalized relative L1 over lanes with mirror offset in [0, 3) / [3, 12) deg, importance weighted (fit104kb.Data formula, denominator clamped at 1e-12).
definitions.region l1 / signed: Luminance region relative L1 and signed energy (eval104k.metrics), region edges 3 / 12 deg.
definitions.crit: Per-probe el1 + ealb + e_core + e_shoulder; S_dev = mean over the 20 probes (protocol selection_criterion_dev).
definitions.el1_grazing: el1 on probes with incident polar >= 75 deg, 0 elsewhere (pooled sum = sum over grazing probes).
definitions.peak: Luminance on all USED grid points (use mask; radius 0 .. 8 deg on the new grids, 0 .. 4 on WL104D): s_h = max F / max R - 1, e_h = |s_h|, e_prof = sum |F - R| / sum R.
definitions.ring residual: Per ring: mean over used azimuths of F / mean of R - 1.
definitions.instability: SD over starts (ddof = 1) of s_h per (material, probe); I = mean over probes then materials.
definitions.pooled contrast: Per start: sum over (material, probe) of X / same sum of O0 - 1 (paired starts); median over starts; cluster bootstrap over materials (10,000 resamples of the material index from one generator seeded 1041350 per cohort, reused by every contrast: common random numbers), 2.5 / 97.5 % of the bootstrap medians.
definitions.resolved: Contrast recomputed against half a and half b: same sign as each other and as the mean-target contrast, and |c_a - c_b| / 2 <= |c| / 4.
definitions.BROAD_PRESERVED vs P_hist: median over X starts of pooled el1 / median over the 4 P_hist starts of pooled el1 - 1 (unpaired).
definitions.material regression: Per material: median over starts of the per-start mean-over-probes el1, X / O0 - 1, applied to all nine materials (protocol pre_freeze_clarifications).
definitions.median-start pooled (E1): Sum over materials of the per-material median over starts of the material-pooled metric.
definitions.spearman: Average ranks; an undefined correlation (constant input) counts as 0 (not > 0).
definitions.synthetic SC medians: Ratio of the medians over starts of the pooled metric (S_X median / S_O0 median).
definitions.O0 reproduction: Per unit (WL104K starts 1-4 x material) |O0 final training objective - WL104K P final objective| / |WL104K P|, recorded per unit: max <= 1e-4 reproduced; 1e-4 < max <= 1e-2 disclosed, every label carries O0_REPRODUCTION_DISCREPANCY ('flags' list and '+O0_REPRODUCTION_DISCREPANCY' label suffix) and stays qualified; max > 1e-2 -> UNQUALIFIED (protocol arms.O0).
definitions.fit data: Every fit's fit.json data_sha256 must equal this run's training data: train_original = the CM.inputs-authenticated WL104J fit_set.npz hash; train_coverage = data_dir equal to <root>/data and the sha256 of <root>/data/train_coverage.npz (FIT_DATA_MISMATCH otherwise).
definitions.leak guard: Test mode refuses unless data104kb.test_lock passes (when present) and the local checks pass: hashed dev decision, unchanged physical + synthetic fits, F present when eligible, protocol / eval104kb.py / decision104kb.py / dev.npz / dev_peak.npz / every dev-time inputs_sha256 entry unchanged, and a non-smoke dev decision for a non-smoke test.
definitions.data authentication: Outside --smoke: data/data.json must exist, the qualification flag of every used set must be stated (not None) and every loaded npz must be hash-verified against data.json outputs_sha256.
definitions.test arms: Physical arms are compared with O0 on paired starts; per-row labels are gated here (UNQUALIFIED on a data, isolation or O0-reproduction failure); the decision adds only contract / leak / dev-hash gating.
